# Jay Liu

> Jay Liu (Jie Liu) is a software engineer based in Auckland, New Zealand. He currently works as an Analyst Developer at FNZ Group. His independent projects cover applied AI, business automation, browser tools, knowledge systems and creative workflows.

## Public website

- [English portfolio](https://jayliu.co.nz/): Background, selected independent projects, skills, experience and contact details.
- [中文个人网站](https://jayliu.co.nz/zh/): Chinese version of the same personal portfolio.
- [Privacy](https://jayliu.co.nz/privacy/): How this website and contact links handle information.

The independent projects and personal views on this website are Jay's own. The website makes no claims about FNZ's AI systems or internal projects.
